title: repo file
description: What a repository says about itself, kept at repo.json in its root: its name, its import name, where it lives, its host metadata, which repositories it depends on and, in an org's rules repo, the org. Format 2; naula's parser reads the same rules and its fixtures prove the two agree.

format.description: The version of this document's shape.

name.description: The repository's name, the only place it is written. Remotes and the local folder take it.
name.fix: write the repo's name: letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores

homes.description: Where the repository lives, the primary first. Required unless the id is local:, and refused when it is.
homes.fix: list where the repo lives, primary first, as { "provider", "account" }, { "provider": "web", "domain" } or { "url" }; only a local: repo has none

id.description: Only for a fork taking its own identity (git:<hex> of its first own commit), or local:<name> for a repo with no home. Absent means the first-parent root.
id.fix: leave id out, or state git:<hex> of the fork's first own commit, or local:<name> for a repo with no home

description.description: A short line saying what the repository is, for the host to show.

topics.description: Topics the repository is filed under on its host.
topics.fix: list at most 20 topics of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 50 characters each

homepage.description: The address of the repository's home page.

settings.description: Settings the host should carry for this repository. A setting left out leaves the host alone.
settings.fix: keep settings to visibility ("public" or "private"), defaultBranch (a name), issues and wiki (true or false)

registries.description: Where the repository's packages are published: the npm scope and the maven group.
registries.fix: name the npm scope and the maven group, for example "@spisor" and "com.spisor"

dependencies.description: The repositories this one builds against, each pinned to a commit.

access.description: Who may read and write the repository, kept opaque here and owned by its own spec.

text.description: Any string that carries no NUL.

value.description: Any JSON value whose strings and member names carry no NUL and whose numbers a double holds.
value.fix: write every number within the range a double holds, and no NUL in any string

folderName.description: A name that becomes a folder: letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, never ., .., .git in any case, a trailing dot or a Windows device name with any extension.

relativePath.description: A relative path inside the repo whose every segment obeys the folder name rules.
relativePath.fix: write a relative path inside the repo with no . or .. segment, for example "siblings/kernel"

importName.description: The compiler-facing name, and the folder a dependency or org takes: lowercase words joined by single hyphens or dots, never a Windows device name.
importName.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens or dots, for example "config-ledger" or "api.http"

gitUrl.description: An https or ssh git url, printable ASCII with no space, at most 2048 characters.

providerHome.description: An account on a provider, optionally at a host of its own.

place.description: Where to start looking for a repo: <provider>:<number>, <provider>@<host>:<number>, web:<domain> or a git url.
place.fix: write the place as <provider>:<number>, <provider>@<host>:<number>, web:<domain> or an https url

referenceRules.description: A reference holds exactly one of id and url; at is required with a git: id and refused with local: or url.

orgReference.description: A reference to an org's rules repo by git: id and places, or by url. Never local:, which can hold no org's rules.

dependency.description: One repository this one builds against, by id and places or by url, pinned to a commit.

id.fix: write the id as git:<root commit hex> or local:<name>, with lowercase path segments

commit.fix: write the full lowercase commit hash, 40 or 64 hex digits

projects.description: The projects an org's folder holds, each with a one line description, keyed by the project's folder name.
projects.fix: describe each project in one line, keyed by a lowercase project folder name

accounts.description: Host accounts the org owns, whose every unarchived repo it holds.

suborg.description: A sub-org whose rules live in this repo.

org.description: The org this repo declares, only in the repo that holds the org's rules.

hold.description: Only in the top org: the orgs a root of this org holds.

org.fix: keep hold in the top org only, as a list of { id, at }
